router.instructions: Which area of banking is this customer message about?

criteria.card_get: Getting, ordering, receiving, activating, linking or replacing a card; card types (virtual, disposable, Visa/Mastercard), card delivery, card PIN setup or change, countries served.
criteria.card_problem: Using the card and app access: where the card is accepted, declined card payments, card not working, contactless, lost/stolen/compromised card or phone, fraud, ATM keeping the card, PIN blocked, forgotten passcode.
criteria.wallet: Apple Pay, Google Pay or smartwatch payments, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.payment: Card payments and charges on the statement: pending/reverted/duplicate/unrecognised payments, fees on card payments, wrong exchange rate on purchases, extra charges, direct debits, refunds.
criteria.cash: Cash withdrawals and ATMs: finding ATMs, withdrawal fees, declined/pending/unrecognised withdrawals, wrong amount or wrong rate.
criteria.top_up: Topping up / adding money to the account: methods, charges, limits, pending/failed/reverted top-ups, verification, which cards/currencies for adding money, cheque or cash deposits.
criteria.transfer: Bank transfers and transactions: sending, receiving, moving money into the account, pending, failed/declined, cancelling or reversing a transaction, fees, timing, beneficiaries, balance not updated after a transfer.
criteria.exchange: Currency exchange: rates, exchange fees, how to exchange, which currencies are supported.
criteria.account: Account and identity: closing account, editing personal details, age requirements, identity verification, source of funds.

card_get.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card the customer already has: how to activate it, activation failing, wanting to start using or reactivate a card.
criteria.card_arrival: A bank card (not a purchased item or package) that was ordered or sent has not arrived yet, or the customer wants to track the card in the post or asks if it is lost in delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How a card will be delivered or sent to the customer, how long card delivery takes in general, whether it can arrive by a certain date, expedited delivery, or where cards can be shipped/delivered to.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app/account, including re-linking or reactivating a card that was lost and later found, or making a newly arrived card show in the app.
criteria.get_physical_card: Where to find or get the PIN for the customer's card, PIN not received, how the PIN of a physical card is obtained.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a new card or wanting a physical (plastic) card: how to order, what ordering costs, where it can be ordered from; requests for a first or new card that are not a replacement for an expiring one, not an additional card besides the one already held, and do not ask for a specific card network.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting or ordering another, additional, second or supplementary card on the same account besides the one the customer already has, a card for a family member, how many cards one can have, fees for extra cards.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Getting a virtual card (non-disposable): how to get or order one, where to find it, virtual card not yet received.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card, who can get one.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits and restrictions of disposable virtual cards: number of uses, what they can be used for.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring or has expired: getting a replacement, what to do, cost and delivery of the replacement.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing, preferring or asking to get a card of one of the two card networks.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service and cards are available in, whether customers living outside the UK/EU can use it.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN, where (ATM, bank, app) the PIN can be changed.

card_problem.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.card_not_working: The card does not work in general (not specifically declined for a purchase at a shop or online, not at an ATM, not contactless, not virtual), e.g. not working anywhere, or repeatedly failing with no shop, purchase or ATM context given.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments with the card are not working.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card (including disposable virtual card) does not work or a payment with it is rejected.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, ate or retained the card.
criteria.compromised_card: Reporting possible fraud on the account; suspicion that someone else has the card details or is using the card fraudulently; wanting to freeze or block the card because of suspicious use while the customer may still have the card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The physical card is lost, missing or stolen and has not been found again.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone is lost, stolen or left behind, so they cannot use the app or want to protect the account.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used or is accepted: which merchants, shops, businesses or places accept it.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or rejected, or a merchant refused the card.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or the account/card is locked after entering the wrong PIN too many times; unblocking the PIN.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten, reset or not working app passcode / login code (not the card PIN).
criteria.found_card_relink: Linking or adding a card to the app/account, including re-linking or reactivating a card that was lost and later found, or making a newly arrived card show in the app.

payment.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra charge was added for paying with the card; why card use costs money.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment, purchase or payment to a merchant on the statement that the customer did not make or does not recognise (not a tiny one-unit charge, not a direct debit, not a cash withdrawal).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase abroad or in a foreign currency got the wrong or a bad exchange rate; also complaints that the rate the customer got was wrong, bad or unfair when cash withdrawal is not mentioned.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase the customer made is still pending and has not gone through (not an unrecognised tiny one-unit charge).
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment the customer made was returned, reversed or cancelled and the money came back to the account, without the customer requesting a refund.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment appears twice / duplicate charges.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small charge of about one unit of currency (one pound, dollar, euro) on the statement or app that the customer cannot explain or does not recognise, even if it is pending; or an additional small amount charged over the price.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised or unauthorised direct debit.
criteria.request_refund: Wanting a refund for a purchase, cancelling a purchase because the customer no longer wants the item, how to get money back from a merchant, return policy.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer was expecting has not arrived or is not showing in the account.
criteria.cancel_own_transaction: The customer wants to cancel, reverse, revert or take back a transfer or transaction they made themselves (e.g. sent to the wrong account), as opposed to cancelling a purchase or asking a merchant for a refund.
criteria.fraud_on_card: Reporting possible fraud on the account; suspicion that someone else has the card details or is using the card fraudulently; wanting to freeze or block the card because of suspicious use while the customer may still have the card.
criteria.where_card_accepted: Where the card can be used or is accepted: which merchants, shops, businesses or places accept it.

cash.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM, why there is a fee for taking out cash (not exchange rates).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or declined the cash withdrawal, the card does not work at an ATM, or the customer cannot take out cash.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending or in progress, including when the ATM failed to give money but the transaction shows in progress.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less or a different amount of cash than requested or than shown in the app.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rates for getting cash: the rate applied when the customer withdrew cash (ATM, especially abroad) was wrong or bad, any complaint about a rate that mentions cash or the amount of cash received, and questions about what rates apply to cash withdrawals or foreign ATMs.

top_up.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic / auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, taking a long time to complete, or not yet visible in the balance.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees or charges for topping up by bank transfer, and questions about using international or interbank transfer schemes such as SWIFT or SEPA with the account (whether they can be used, received, or what they cost).
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card, cost of topping up with a card (including foreign or US cards).
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / adding money with cash or a cheque: whether and how.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, or did not go through, or produced an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (not one made with a card) appeared and then the money was taken back / reverted / disappeared from the balance.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Adding money to the account using a debit or credit card, including when phrased as transferring money with a card, and whether other people can top up the account; how to do it, or any problem with a top-up made with a card where the money left the card or vanished but did not arrive (this takes priority over the reverted and failed top-up intents).
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for a top-up, finding the top-up verification code, and why verification is needed when topping up.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which kinds or brands of cards (credit, debit, particular card networks or issuers, cards from which countries) and which currencies can be used to add money / top up, including whether or why a particular card brand works for adding money.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or a cheque was deposited (a deposit) but the balance has not updated, the deposit is slow, or the customer asks when the deposit will show.
criteria.top_up_with_wallet: Topping up through Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_how: Whether or how one can top up / add money by bank transfer from another account (not about fees).

transfer.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer (sent or received) has been made but it does not show or appear in the account, or the balance has not updated.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, a beneficiary is not allowed, or a transfer to a particular account or person is not possible or not allowed (the customer cannot send to that account or is told the transfer is not possible), as opposed to a transfer explicitly described as declined or failed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel, reverse, revert or take back a transfer or transaction they made themselves (e.g. sent to the wrong account), as opposed to cancelling a purchase or asking a merchant for a refund.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, could not be completed or showed an error, including large payments such as for a property or mortgage that get an error.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer made is described as still pending or in progress, or they ask why it is pending.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money from someone else: friends or other people sending money, salary paid in.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer; why transfers cost money.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move the customer's own money into this account by bank transfer from another bank account (not using a card), including whether and how topping up by bank transfer works.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent a specific transfer and says the money has not arrived or reached the destination, is not there yet, or the recipient has not received it, even if they also ask how long it takes (if they only say it does not show or appear in the account, see balance not updated).
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive (in general or from/to a country), or how much longer to wait, when the customer does not say the money failed to reach the recipient.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_fee: Fees or charges for topping up by bank transfer, and questions about using international or interbank transfer schemes such as SWIFT or SEPA with the account (whether they can be used, received, or what they cost).

exchange.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: Questions about what the exchange rates are, where they come from, why they change (not complaints that a rate applied to the customer was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Using the app to exchange currencies: how to do it, or whether the customer can exchange money or exchange one currency into another using the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange, including whether exchanges involving a specific named currency are allowed or supported by the bank (a question about currency coverage, not about using the app's exchange feature).

account.instructions: Which specific intent does this customer message express?

criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account, accounts for children.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name or address.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification was attempted and is failing, the customer cannot prove who they are, or the app does not recognise them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity and what documents are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required (not verification asked for during a top-up), whether it is really necessary, and what happens or whether the account can be used if verification is not done or not finished.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: showing, seeing or verifying where the money in the account came from, or wanting to see the available funds and their origin; whether salary or income details must be added.

criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used or is accepted: which merchants, shops, businesses or places accept it.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or rejected, or a merchant refused the card.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or the account/card is locked after entering the wrong PIN too many times; unblocking the PIN.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten, reset or not working app passcode / login code (not the card PIN).
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee or extra charge was added for paying with the card; why card use costs money.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment, purchase or payment to a merchant on the statement that the customer did not make or does not recognise (not a tiny one-unit charge, not a direct debit, not a cash withdrawal).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase abroad or in a foreign currency got the wrong or a bad exchange rate; also complaints that the rate the customer got was wrong, bad or unfair when cash withdrawal is not mentioned.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase the customer made is still pending and has not gone through (not an unrecognised tiny one-unit charge).
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment the customer made was returned, reversed or cancelled and the money came back to the account, without the customer requesting a refund.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment appears twice / duplicate charges.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small charge of about one unit of currency (one pound, dollar, euro) on the statement or app that the customer cannot explain or does not recognise, even if it is pending; or an additional small amount charged over the price.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised or unauthorised direct debit.
criteria.request_refund: Wanting a refund for a purchase, cancelling a purchase because the customer no longer wants the item, how to get money back from a merchant, return policy.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer was expecting has not arrived or is not showing in the account.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM, why there is a fee for taking out cash (not exchange rates).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or declined the cash withdrawal, the card does not work at an ATM, or the customer cannot take out cash.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is shown as pending or in progress, including when the ATM failed to give money but the transaction shows in progress.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less or a different amount of cash than requested or than shown in the app.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rates for getting cash: the rate applied when the customer withdrew cash (ATM, especially abroad) was wrong or bad, any complaint about a rate that mentions cash or the amount of cash received, and questions about what rates apply to cash withdrawals or foreign ATMs.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Automatic / auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, taking a long time to complete, or not yet visible in the balance.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees or charges for topping up by bank transfer, and questions about using international or interbank transfer schemes such as SWIFT or SEPA with the account (whether they can be used, received, or what they cost).
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card, cost of topping up with a card (including foreign or US cards).
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / adding money with cash or a cheque: whether and how.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, or did not go through, or produced an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (not one made with a card) appeared and then the money was taken back / reverted / disappeared from the balance.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Adding money to the account using a debit or credit card, including when phrased as transferring money with a card, and whether other people can top up the account; how to do it, or any problem with a top-up made with a card where the money left the card or vanished but did not arrive (this takes priority over the reverted and failed top-up intents).
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for a top-up, finding the top-up verification code, and why verification is needed when topping up.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which kinds or brands of cards (credit, debit, particular card networks or issuers, cards from which countries) and which currencies can be used to add money / top up, including whether or why a particular card brand works for adding money.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Cash or a cheque was deposited (a deposit) but the balance has not updated, the deposit is slow, or the customer asks when the deposit will show.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer (sent or received) has been made but it does not show or appear in the account, or the balance has not updated.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, a beneficiary is not allowed, or a transfer to a particular account or person is not possible or not allowed (the customer cannot send to that account or is told the transfer is not possible), as opposed to a transfer explicitly described as declined or failed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel, reverse, revert or take back a transfer or transaction they made themselves (e.g. sent to the wrong account), as opposed to cancelling a purchase or asking a merchant for a refund.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, could not be completed or showed an error, including large payments such as for a property or mortgage that get an error.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer made is described as still pending or in progress, or they ask why it is pending.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money from someone else: friends or other people sending money, salary paid in.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee charged for a transfer; why transfers cost money.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move the customer's own money into this account by bank transfer from another bank account (not using a card), including whether and how topping up by bank transfer works.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent a specific transfer and says the money has not arrived or reached the destination, is not there yet, or the recipient has not received it, even if they also ask how long it takes (if they only say it does not show or appear in the account, see balance not updated).
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive (in general or from/to a country), or how much longer to wait, when the customer does not say the money failed to reach the recipient.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: Questions about what the exchange rates are, where they come from, why they change (not complaints that a rate applied to the customer was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Using the app to exchange currencies: how to do it, or whether the customer can exchange money or exchange one currency into another using the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange, including whether exchanges involving a specific named currency are allowed or supported by the bank (a question about currency coverage, not about using the app's exchange feature).
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account, accounts for children.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name or address.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification was attempted and is failing, the customer cannot prove who they are, or the app does not recognise them.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity and what documents are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required (not verification asked for during a top-up), whether it is really necessary, and what happens or whether the account can be used if verification is not done or not finished.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: showing, seeing or verifying where the money in the account came from, or wanting to see the available funds and their origin; whether salary or income details must be added.
